hypothesis: The original readout can change an unwritten verdict. At the same sparse write and 60-degree query cap, encourage the unwritten head read to remain aligned with the native unwritten read while still maximizing normalized written-minus-unwritten contrast. The protection weight is 1 for unit target scales.
controls: Compare the original solver and an interpolation along the original query direction matched per slot to the candidate's unwritten-read displacement. Every method uses all 24 previously exposed VitaminC pilot pages, both editions and both claims. The new reader consumes only internal states. Native/sham and white results are already archived.
gate: Require at least as many correct changed endpoints as the original, at least two additional sham verdicts matching the recipient, no previously correct stable verdict loss, and more correct changed endpoints than the matched-drift control. No independent test of a failed rule.
budget: Local Apple M5, 1200 seconds, one repair allowance and no paid service. This pilot tests control and preservation, not wall-time improvement.
